QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] The Puppeteer's Goal
QuestInfo.0: Horny Mushrooms turning angry... Is that more of the Puppeteer's work? Listen in.
QuestInfo.1: Pia claims to have seen monsters in town. Go look for them at the #bPet Walkway#k.\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: Just as Pia claimed, there are monsters in town. You found more evidence of the Puppeteer's work as well. Is he planning to raid the town?
